description: Implementation of ProductDao for database operations related to Product entities, including retrieval by URL, ID, code, and filtering by categories, store, and locale.

classes.name: ProductDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Product entity, providing methods for product retrieval and filtering.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a Product by its SEO URL within a specific store and locale.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Fetches products for a store filtered by category IDs, language, and locale.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products belonging to specified categories.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve products by categories with language filtering.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products available in a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves products in a store based on filtering criteria and pagination.

methods.name: getProductsListForLocale
methods.description: Internal method to fetch products for a store and categories filtered by locale, with pagination.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a specific product by ID, filtered by locale and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its SKU code and language.
